name: cavemio-cart
title: Cart
description: A cart whose receipt does the maths in front of you: codes are stamped on, a rail of light fills toward free shipping and every total rolls.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Each quantity is a labelled stepper ("Quantity of Linen overshirt"); row errors are alerts under their row and the code field’s error is tied to it.
- Removing and Undo, applied codes and removed codes are announced from a status region; totals are read as whole amounts.
- The free-shipping rail is a meter with its percentage; its words change, never a live region that chatters.
- Nothing leaves the cart until Undo has run out, and a change that’s still being sent is replaced by the next one rather than queued.
- Its light comes from your theme: the receipt mixes --primary-foreground into --primary, tiles take tints from --chart-1 to --chart-5, and 1px edges catch the light in light and dark. No drop shadows, glow or blur.
- Built from Input, Stepper input, Number roll, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library; with reduced motion rows and totals change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: items
props.description: – · { id, name, variant?, price, quantity, max?, image?, icon? }. price is per unit; max caps the stepper (stock).

props.name: onQuantityChange
props.description: – · Called once the presses stop; throw an Error to put the quantity back and show why.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: – · Called when Undo runs out (4s); throw to bring the row back with your message.

props.name: onApplyCode
props.description: – · Return { code, percent } or { code, amount }; throw an Error to show why it didn’t apply.

props.name: onRemoveCode
props.description: – · Called when the chip’s × is pressed.

props.name: onCheckout
props.description: – · Gets { items, code, subtotal, discount, shipping, total }; start checkout and redirect.

props.name: discount
props.description: – · The applied code if you keep it yourself; otherwise the cart remembers what onApplyCode returned.

props.name: shipping / freeShippingAt
props.description: – · Flat shipping, and the order value (after discount) that ships free; the second draws the rail.

props.name: title / currency / locale
props.description: "Your cart" / "USD" / browser · The heading, and how every amount is formatted.

useCases.title: Store carts

useCases.title: Order review
useCases.description: The step before payment, with codes and shipping worked out in front of the buyer.

useCases.title: Add-ons and seats
useCases.description: Extras on a subscription checkout, each with its own quantity.

useCases.title: Event tickets
useCases.description: Ticket types with quantities, a promo code and fees on one receipt.

features.title: Totals you can watch
features.description: Every line, the subtotal, discount, shipping and total roll the way they changed.

features.title: One request per change
features.description: Quantities are sent once you stop pressing; a refusal puts the row back and shows your message under it.

features.title: Remove with Undo
features.description: The row folds into Undo over a draining thin line; onRemove is only called when it runs out.

features.title: Codes stamped on
features.description: onApplyCode returns a percent or an amount; the code lands as a chip and the discount rolls into the receipt.

features.title: Free shipping you can see
features.description: A rail of light fills toward freeShippingAt and says exactly what is left to add.

features.title: Checkout in place
features.description: onCheckout gets the items, code and totals; Check out goes Opening checkout → Redirecting, or says why not.

states.title: cart
states.description: Rows with a tinted tile (or photo), name, variant, a stepper and a line total; under them the code field; then the lit receipt with the shipping rail, the lines and the total.

states.title: quantity
states.description: The stepper’s count, the line total and the receipt roll at once (700–1000ms); the change is sent 450ms after the last press, and the line dims while it’s saving.

states.title: refused
states.description: If onQuantityChange throws, the row goes back to your quantity, shakes once and shows the message under it.

states.title: removed
states.description: The row turns into "Removed · Undo" in 460ms with a thin line draining over 4s; totals already leave it out. Undo brings it back; otherwise it folds away and onRemove runs.

states.title: code
states.description: Apply goes Checking; the field turns into a dashed chip that is stamped on (lands at 1.5× tilted out of a 6px blur and is thrown flat in 560ms) and the discount line opens in the receipt and rolls. A refusal shakes the field and shows the reason.

states.title: free shipping
states.description: The rail’s light and its head glide to the new share (700ms); crossing the line swaps "Add $12 for free shipping" for "Free shipping unlocked" and Shipping morphs to Free.

states.title: checkout
states.description: Check out → Opening checkout → Redirecting with a drawn check; a failure shakes into Try again and replaces the tax note with your message.
